AI Overview
Super Star Car is a free, browser-based 3D Formula 1 racing and driving game developed by Barnzmu. You can play it online on platforms like CrazyGames or Super Star Car. 
Game Overview & Features
Gameplay: You race in a career mode across 14 circuits (such as Arcport Circuit, Yafield Park, and Riverside Circuit) to earn money and stars. 
Upgrades: Spend your in-game earnings to improve car performance, including speed, acceleration, and handling. 
Controls:
WASD or Arrow Keys to steer and accelerate.
C to cycle through camera views (driver, chase, and bird's-eye).
Spacebar to respawn if you crash or go off-track.
Xbox Controller is also supported. 
Note: If you were instead looking for Super Star Car Wash (a chain with locations across Arizona, Texas, California, and Colorado), memberships and unlimited wash tiers are available on the Super Star Car Wash Official Website.
